response.original_title: [Dispute-Guide] Marella Cruises Charge Dispute: How to Request a Resolution
response.overview: You can contact TUI Customer Support for Marella Cruises by calling 0120 420 8151 in the UK and selecting the relevant cruise option. For complaints and post-travel queries, TUI lists the official complaints line at +0120 420 8151, or you can use the TUI After Travel Online Form. Dispute and Complaint Steps Call Customer Service: Dial 0120 420 8151 with your booking reference number, receipts, and details ready. Ask for a Supervisor: Request an escalation if the first agent cannot resolve your billing error +1 866-254-7549 or dispute. Submit Documentation Online: Use the official TUI Contact Portal to submit written proof of incorrect charges or service issues +1 866-254-7549. Contact Your Bank: File a formal credit card chargeback with your financial institution as a final resort if the internal review remains unresolved.
